summary.text: In undated pre-confirmation written answers, Roth described AI as offering tremendous consumer benefits while carrying risks, and pledged to harness it for competitiveness, national security, and human flourishing. On February 25, 2026, Roth warned that authoritarian dominance of technologies including AI could embed surveillance, censorship, and centralized control into next-generation networks. On June 30, 2026, speaking as Assistant Secretary, Roth announced plans for a funding opportunity using the remaining $53 million in the Public Wireless Supply Chain Innovation Fund to explore a domestic, exportable AI-native 6G stack.

statements.text: NTIA is working across the full internet stack to advance American technology leadership and resist foreign mission creep. statements.text: AI is becoming an increasingly important part of the internet economy. While AI has the potential to deliver tremendous benefits to consumers, it also comes with risks. If confirmed, I will work to ensure that we lead the world on AI, and harness AI to promote economic competitiveness, national security, and human flourishing.
